Independent literal allowed/denied rows span two timestamps exactly24h apart and two sessions. Positive final2 is the first sensitive assertion. Missing denied/session/day negatives match actual gate requirements; higher statuses stay not_evaluated.

Date.now-derived timestamps remain fresh; no global timers, Date overrides, environment writes or registry-dependent row generation. One supplied event with duplicate tags remains one L1 match; no cross-object event-ID dedup claim.

Parser cases use an explicit local trustList:null reader. Known manual/import/dogfood markers conservatively derive tier/admission; unboundATTESTED never reaches trust loading. Source root derives from materialized import.meta.url and realpath, not borrowed runner cwd. RequiresMeta tests only own-property presence, including undefined.

Literal fixed test declarations; mutable registry/map loops are inside bodies. No-seeder/no-synthetic test is separate and precedes literal correspondence. M2 directly reaches seeder rejection; later synthetic assertion in that same body may be masked after the first failure, while a separate literal test may also fail. Actual root classification must preserve that distinction.

No owned workspace, file output, native/SQL/network/process call, env mutation, global prototype mutation or cleanup harness is introduced. Object.setPrototypeOf targets one local synthetic metadata object. Console markers contain only finite synthetic observations, with no credentials/env values.

M1 highest-pass sees pass/fail/pass graph. M2 seeder truth has an independent fixed body. M3 denied removal retains fixture row literals and lowers the canonical synthetic two-day positive; actual control outcomes remain unexecuted/uncredited.
